layer: Moon temperature (moon.html, optional): What LRO measured: brightness temperature around local noon / local midnight
kind: derived page file from a measurement-derived product (Diviner team bins); our own second step is the window mean; not live

source.product: Diviner Global Cumulative Product (GCP), data set LRO-L-DLRE-5-GCP-V1.0, field tbol
source.citation: Paige, D.A.; Sullivan, M.T.; Williams, J.-P. (2022). LRO Diviner Derived Data Products. NASA PDS. https://doi.org/10.17189/wj0s-w188
source.files: 18 band files global_cumul_avg_cyl_<band>_002.tab, each 156,211,313 B; archive MD5s in docs/research/moon-lro-science/SAMPLES.md §6.4
source.grid: 0.5 deg cells, 96 local-time bins of 0.25 h (centres 0.125 + 0.25k h)
source.processing_reference: Diviner RDR SIS v1.21 §8.1: mean channel 3-9 radiances per bin determine the bolometric brightness temperature
source.general_definition: Powell et al. 2023, JGR Planets 128, e2022JE007532, §2.5 (read by Claude 26 Nov 2026; see SAMPLES §6.8): an equivalent blackbody temperature of the wavelength-integrated flux
source.also_cited: Williams, J.-P. et al. 2017, Icarus 283, 300-325 (the GCP label gives its DOI with a typo)
source.rights: PDS Geosciences FAQ: 'Data sets archived in the PDS are in the public domain'; cite the bundle DOI

statistic: For each 0.5 deg cell and window, the unweighted arithmetic mean of the available quarter-hour tbol bin values within an hour of local noon (bins 46-49, 11:30-12:30) or local midnight (bins 94, 95, 0, 1, 23:30-00:30). Empty (-9999) and invalid (-9998) bins are omitted. n = bins used (0-4). Range = max - min of the bins used, only for n >= 2; it is not an uncertainty. Not a bolometric temperature for the hour, and with fewer than four bins not a fully sampled hourly average.

coding.value: u16: 0 = no valid data in this window, 1 = withheld (display policy), v >= 2 -> v/10 K, mean rounded half up to 0.1 K
coding.range: u8 whole K rounded half up; 254 = at least 253.5 K (display capped); 255 = unavailable (n <= 1, no valid data, withheld)
coding.rounding_note: values are rounded to 0.1 K; the rounding is not the accuracy

masks.noon: withheld poleward of 70 deg (cell centres beyond 70)
masks.nature: our display policy, not the edge of Diviner coverage and not a guarantee of small spread inside it

comparison_ghrm.what: Centre-cell differences, this map minus the GHRM midnight tbol mosaic (dghrm_tbol_m_70s70n_img) as 0.5-degree block means, at 20 sites
comparison_ghrm.result: ten selected high-contrast midnight sites (our own grid maxima): -1.9 to +16.7 K, median +8.7 K; ten fixed background sites: +0.05 to +0.82 K
comparison_ghrm.caveat: The products use different processing, sampling and periods; the causes of the differences have not been isolated. This comparison is not an accuracy estimate. The high-contrast sites were selected from this map, so they are not a random sample.
comparison_ghrm.registration: the true alignment scored better on average than one-cell shifts, a 180-degree shift and local 3 x 3 reflections; this supports the grid orientation, and does not exclude local pointing or effective-footprint differences

scales.shares_are_of: equal-angle 0.5 deg grid cells, not lunar surface area
scales.rule: one fixed sequential ramp; per mode the ends are the 1st and 99th percentiles of valid displayed cells, rounded outward to whole K; computed once, never per view; clipped cells keep their exact value in the readout

gcp-tbol-nm-R1.bin.gz.format: MEDIVNR1 schema 1: 64-byte header then planes P1 noon value u16, P2 midnight value u16, P3 noon n, P4 midnight n, P5 noon range, P6 midnight range; 720 columns from 0.25 E eastward, 360 rows from 89.75 N southward; little-endian (MOON-DIVINER-PROPOSAL rev 2 §6.2)
